name: canvas
description: Local no-op stand-in for the optional native `canvas` package. jsdom treats canvas as an OPTIONAL peer and runs fine without it; installing the real one requires a native build that is not available in CI or the sandbox, and a half-installed copy makes every jsdom test fail at import with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Exporting an object with no createCanvas makes jsdom's feature probe fall back to no-canvas mode.
